extras: Private by default; no network requests or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Inkplane gives handwriting and sketches their own dedicated space inside Obsidian.
problem: Traditional note-taking methods constrain handwriting and sketches to fixed note dimensions or require external tools, making it difficult to integrate freeform drawing into the Obsidian workflow.
summary: Inkplane provides an infinite, native canvas within Obsidian for creating and embedding handwritten notes and sketches using pens like the Apple Pencil.
